saw_lines: Police and tactical gear buyers compare fit, durability and reviews, and many shop for a specific job or training course.
So the sale is won or lost in the first click, when a first-time buyer decides whether this shop is worth trusting.
Your 107 Google creatives include 24 text, 13 image and 3 video ads, so test a first-order offer in the text ads and a customer review line on each image.
ads_1: Google text ads leading with a first-order offer, tested against a customer review line
